\section[(dialogue)]{Can, want, why and places — a first pass}

\label{lesson:PT-R92-first-pass-can-want-why-and-places}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a bus and a train.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to be able to, to have to, a need, a trade, to take
  \item to want, I would like, to prefer, to wish, a wish
  \item a reason, a reason, so, that is why, a cause
  \item an airport, a stop, the post office, a cinema, a town hall
  \item a supermarket, a petrol station, a swimming pool, a stadium, a factory
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To be able to? (\textbf{poder}.) To have to? (\textbf{dever}.) A need? (\textbf{a necessidade}.) A trade? (\textbf{o ofício}.) To take? (\textbf{levar}.) To want? (\textbf{querer}.) I would like? (\textbf{gostaria}.) To prefer? (\textbf{preferir}.) To wish? (\textbf{desejar}.) A wish? (\textbf{o desejo}.) A reason? (\textbf{a razão}.) A reason? (\textbf{o motivo}.) So? (\textbf{então}.) That is why? (\textbf{por isso}.) A cause? (\textbf{a causa}.) An airport? (\textbf{o aeroporto}.) A stop? (\textbf{a paragem}.) The post office? (\textbf{os correios}.) A cinema? (\textbf{o cinema}.) A town hall? (\textbf{a câmara municipal}.) A supermarket? (\textbf{o supermercado}.) A petrol station? (\textbf{a bomba de gasolina}.) A swimming pool? (\textbf{a piscina}.) A stadium? (\textbf{o estádio}.) A factory? (\textbf{a fábrica}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Getting around and the house — a second pass}

\label{lesson:PT-R92-second-pass-getting-around-and-the-house}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for an office and a street corner.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item an office, a street corner, a crossroads, traffic lights, a car park
  \item a lift, the north, the south, the east, the west
  \item straight ahead; opposite, behind, next to, between, a neighbourhood
  \item a pavement; a walk, a kiosk, a pastry shop, a bakery, a butcher's
  \item the underground, a tram, a journey, holidays, a bicycle
  \item a motorbike, a ship, a boat, a bus, a train
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
An office? (\textbf{o escritório}.) A street corner? (\textbf{a esquina}.) A crossroads? (\textbf{o cruzamento}.) Traffic lights? (\textbf{o semáforo}.) A car park? (\textbf{o estacionamento}.) A lift? (\textbf{o elevador}.) The north? (\textbf{o norte}.) The south? (\textbf{o sul}.) The east? (\textbf{o leste}.) The west? (\textbf{o oeste}.) Straight ahead; opposite? (\textbf{em frente}.) Behind? (\textbf{atrás}.) Next to? (\textbf{ao lado}.) Between? (\textbf{entre}.) A neighbourhood? (\textbf{o bairro}.) A pavement; a walk? (\textbf{o passeio}.) A kiosk? (\textbf{o quiosque}.) A pastry shop? (\textbf{a pastelaria}.) A bakery? (\textbf{a padaria}.) A butcher's? (\textbf{o talho}.) The underground? (\textbf{o metro}.) A tram? (\textbf{o elétrico}.) A journey? (\textbf{a viagem}.) Holidays? (\textbf{as férias}.) A bicycle? (\textbf{a bicicleta}.) A motorbike? (\textbf{a mota}.) A ship? (\textbf{o navio}.) A boat? (\textbf{o barco}.) A bus? (\textbf{o autocarro}.) A train? (\textbf{o comboio}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
